# Aqua glass theme (community-maintained fork)
English | 中文
> **Upstream notice**: this package continues from **WYH66666666**'s DSH-Transparent-UI-Plugin (publ
ished on npm as `dsh-client-ui-aqua`) at **v1.3.0**. The original author states he cannot keep up wi
th new DSH APIs, so this fork fixes and adapts that code. It is **not guaranteed** to work with futu
re DSH versions — back up your profile before upgrading DSH.
## Supported DSH version
| Item | Value |

| **DSH desktop / web** | **the whole 0.2.x line** |
| Host client packages | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-clie

nt-*` **0.2.x** |
| Declared range | `package.json` → `engines.dsh: ">=0.2.1-0 <0.3.0"` |
| Declared
in metadata | `package.json` → `engines.dsh: ">=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0"` |
**V0.2.1-rc.2 is the version this release is built and verified against** — the theme hooks are read
from that host build (page-head markup, composer/dock seams, slot names). These are private client
surfaces, so a DSH upgrade can break the look or the mount even though nothing changes here. If you
are on another DSH build, treat the theme as unsupported and keep a profile backup.
## Topics / community listing
Published under the `dsh-plugin` topic, so it shows up on the dsh-plugin community page alongside ot
her DeepSeek Harness plugins.

Aqua is a highly customizable glassmorphism theme for the DeepSeek Harness web UI and desktop app. T
he floating header, composer and stats line, and the trajectory view become panes of frosted glass,
while the main column can sit on the living fluid board or on your own wallpaper (image or video); t
he sidebar keeps its stock look. Switch it off and the stock UI comes back exactly, with no source c
hanges to DSH itself.
## Differences from upstream v1.3.0
| Item | Upstream v1.3.0 | This package v2.0.5 |
| Layout modes | **Mica + Compatibility**, switchable | **Mica only** — compatibility mode and its s

elector are removed (tokens and styles too) |
| Edge blur bands | 5px gradient blur bands at the top
/bottom (an upstream feature) | **Removed** — they read as an extra gradient wash over the page edge

s; readability is carried by the column veil instead (the 13px edge fade stays) |
| Submenu opacity

| not available | **New** setting, default 96%, a fill stop alongside the chat slab veil |
| Submenu
click | opens on hover, then a click closes it | **New "click keeps it open"**: a hover-opened subm
enu survives the click and closes on the next one; works at any depth via ARIA, keyboard Enter unaff

ected |
| Popup material | `62% × frost` fill (≈8.7% by default), text behind was legible through it

| **96%** fill + `blur + 4px`, panels no longer show the text behind |
| Composer and stats line |

two panes with a 6px gap | **one continuous piece of glass** (single radius, hairline divider) |
| L
ight-mode conversation area | if the host or a skin plugin wrote the column background, the veil los
t and the area went all-white; the opacity knob did nothing | **Fixed**: the veil is `!important` an

d also matches `[class*='centerCol']`, so it no longer depends on stamp timing |
| Scheme switching
| switching to dark left the backdrop light until a knob was touched | **Fixed**: the layer watches

`body[data-ds-dark-theme]` and recomputes the fluid palette, glow tone and brightness direction |

data-ds-dark-theme]` and recomputes the fluid palette, glow tone and brightness direction |

## Features (current)
- **Mica layout**: floating glass header, composer, stats line and trajectory view, with adjustable

blur and frost
- **Theme control panel**: one page collects every knob — colours, wallpaper, opacity

, blur and decor
- **No 3D tilt on the composer**: the 3D effect is gone — it interfered with text r

endering
- **Swappable faces**: body, code and explanatory copy each get their own picker with syste
m / open-source / free-for-commercial presets, plus local `.ttf`, `.otf`, `.woff` and `.woff2` impor

ts (≤ 24 MB each, kept in IndexedDB so they survive reinstalls)
- **Sizes and weights**: three sizes
(body / code / terminal), body and heading weights, and the explanatory face / weight / strength, e

ach adjustable on its own; weight sliders label every discrete stop
- **Free backdrop**: the living
fluid board (hue and depth adjustable) or your own wallpaper — images and video both supported; wall

papers have their own blur and frost, video adds a brightness knob
- **Desktop scheme following**: t
racks the desktop app's light/dark switch and re-tunes the palette, glow and brightness direction on

its own
- **Background brightness**: follows the resolved scheme — dark 0–50 darkens, light 50–100

brightens, 50 is unchanged
- **Two conversation blurs**: one for an open session record, one for pag

es opened from the left menu; the sidebar's state picks between them
- **Submenu opacity**: fill str

ength for popups (menus, dropdowns, quick-invoke panels), independent of the cards
- **Submenu displ
ay**: popups get a 96% fill plus extra blur, so multi-level menus stay legible above the transcript
- **Submenu interaction → click keeps it open**: a hover-opened submenu stays open when clicked, and

closes on the next click
- **Ambient decor**: particle whale (the deepseek.com/harness centerpiece)

, fish, and the interactive mesh — each toggleable
- **Hover effects → cursor glow**: a highlight th

at follows the pointer
- **Glossy "Harness" badge**: dark mode swaps the sidebar wordmark for the of

ficial nameplate pill
- **Edge fade**: a 13px fade so content melts into the viewport edges
